title: Record XP/milestone awards as auditable state mutations
description: Add domain mutations (mutateState.ts / domainMutations.ts) to award XP or grant a milestone, writing append-only rows to the progression-event ledger and updating current XP/advancement state. Awards are deterministic, validated, and replayable — no LLM involvement in the math. Consults the advancement policy.
acceptance_criteria: award-XP and grant-milestone mutations exist; each writes an auditable ledger row and updates state atomically; invalid awards are rejected; tests cover both modes and ledger integrity.
notes: Award API implemented in domainMutations.ts (awardXp + grantMilestone), policy-aware/fail-closed, atomic ledger+state writes. PR #338 open for review. 8 new tests in progressionAwards.test.ts; full verify green.
